resources.string: Show notifications on the external screen
Off: no banners, new ones are only counted; the side panel still opens
A wireless receiver shows the app name only until you choose here
Off — tap to open the system page
Without the notification access everything works as before: no banners, an empty centre. Give XDesk the access below and the phone\'s notifications show on the external screen.

XDesk shows your phone\'s notifications on the external screen: banners in the corner, and a centre where they stay. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere — the content lives in memory only. The system asks you to allow it on the next page.
Fades during full-screen video; the corner and Ctrl+Alt+N still open the centre
Let XDesk switch Do not disturb
The switch sets the phone\'s Do not disturb, as the system\'s quick settings would. Android asks you to allow that on the next page.
Please unlock the phone — then it opens

XDesk can show your phone\'s notifications on the external screen: banners in the top-right corner and a notification centre (rest the pointer in the top-right corner, or Ctrl+Alt+N). It needs the system\'s notification access. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere. Without it everything else works as before; you can turn it on later in XDesk settings → Notifications.
The notification centre needs the notification access: XDesk settings → Notifications

Since Android 13 an app not installed from a store must be let through first: on XDesk\'s app info page, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then come back and turn the access on. If ⋮ has no such item, tap the switch once so the system shows its notice, then look again.
